title: False positive: test seed data formatted into INSERT in unit test
evidence: demo-store-api/tests/test_search.py:13 builds an INSERT with an f-string, but the only values are the loop index `i` and entries from the hardcoded SEED_EMAILS constant (line 7). The function seed() is called only from the test at line 20, against a temporary SQLite file (lines 18-19). This test code is not part of the deployed app (main.py imports nothing from tests/), and no attacker-controlled input reaches it.
recommended_fix: No security fix needed. As optional hygiene, use a parameterized query: conn.execute("INSERT INTO orders VALUES (?, ?, 10.0, 'OPEN')", (i, email)). You could also exclude tests/ from this rule or suppress it there.
